{{Top|leg}}
A '''market''' was a level of territorial organization within the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Territory Administration]], below the level of [[zone]]. It was the smallest territorial unit, generating an income of fifty billion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Each market was run by a [[Supervisor (Corporate Sector Authority)|Supervisor]].
